threat_summary: A fake invoice Excel attachment launches mshta, retrieves a remote payload, creates Registry Run Key persistence, then connects to unknown HTTPS domains.
key_behaviors: host connects to newly registered or uncategorized HTTPS domain
mitre_mapping: T1547.001 - Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
hunt_checklist: Find hosts where excel.exe spawned mshta.exe.
Check whether mshta.exe made outbound web requests.
Check Registry Run Key creation on the same hosts.
Correlate process, registry, and network events within 24 hours.
correlation_logic: Correlate behavior on the same host/user within a 24-hour window unless the report specifies a narrower time range.
escalation_condition: Escalate when the same host shows Office-to-mshta process chain plus persistence or suspicious network activity.
analyst_notes: Generated as synthetic gold output for MVP evaluation. Queries should be reviewed against the real SIEM/EDR schema.
